title: Eligibility Check Missing Court Order Validation
description: Risk Criteria team identified that the eligibility check module does not validate court order expiry dates before approving case referrals. This is causing incorrect eligibility approvals. Affected: Eligibility Service, Case Referral workflow. Business impact: compliance risk, incorrect case assignments being made.

logs.text: 48hr RCA follow-up completed. Root cause confirmed as Requirement Issue — court order expiry validation was never included in original requirements. Intake INT-0892 submitted to Risk Criteria team. PBR scheduled. Design discussion and LOE estimates to be taken from Tech team. Release quarter to be confirmed post-PBR.

title: Payment Gateway Timeout - Checkout Failures
description: Payment gateway intermittently timing out on the checkout flow since 14:00 AEST. Approximately 15% of transactions are failing. Affected systems: Payment Service API, Order Management Service. Customer impact: orders not completing, revenue loss ongoing. Error: Connection timeout after 30s on POST /api/payments/process. SRE team alerted and monitoring.

logs.text: Production issue raised by Risk Criteria team. PO POC and Tech team engaged. SRE team alerted.
